objective: Distinguish genuinely executable <=90d 2x events from illiquid chart doublers without using future outcomes to choose liquidity thresholds or data coverage.

strict_microstructure_window.snapshot_clock_rule: snapshots must be timestamped at or before the frozen decision cutoff; no post-cutoff interpolation

strict_band_rules.rule: A notional band is STRICT_TRADABLE only when PIT spread and executable ask-side depth/VWAP evidence satisfy every strict threshold across the frozen window.

proxy_liquidity_tag.name: PROXY_LIQUID_NOT_STRICT
proxy_liquidity_tag.eligible_input: PIT trailing-30d median spot quote volume
proxy_liquidity_tag.warning: This proxy may prioritize data collection but may not be promoted to STRICT_TRADABLE or used as proof that a historical 2x was realistically executable.

requirements: raw capture or archive bytes retained
data_520_priority: historical spot bid/ask spread and order-book depth
cross-venue spot liquidity for venue-migration sensitivity
data_provenance_contract.collection_rule: Collect a feature family only when it serves this frozen tradability contract or another separately predeclared precursor hypothesis.

evaluation_precommitment.matched_control_requirement: same PIT eligible universe and decision clock; matching pool frozen before outcome reveal

hypothesis.claim: Among PIT-eligible large-move cases, 2x paths preceded by broad spot participation and sufficient executable spot depth are more likely to remain realistically tradable than 2x paths dominated by thin books or leverage-only price discovery.
hypothesis.fact: PIT daily quote volume is available in the current Cohort 001 design but does not prove executable depth or spread.
hypothesis.inference: Microstructure evidence can separate market-cap/chart moves from realizable position entry at explicit notionals.
hypothesis.hypothesis_only: Spot-led versus leverage-led decomposition may improve precision for durable 2x candidates, but no such lift is currently established.
hypothesis.unknown: Historical PIT order-book/depth coverage may be too sparse for powered inference; if so the result remains UNKNOWN rather than substituting current or post-move liquidity.
